note: hand-drawn-t.svg, Josh's own t (Josh: "Export the f a t, so I can fix them up as well.", then "t is ready"), drawn over references/export-t.svg (the built t over Pugin's, one unit to the plate's pixel) and saved trimmed to the drawing. At one unit to the pixel, where the parts he kept from the built t stand where they did: the foot's point and the end of its spur give this offset to a thousandth of a pixel, and the stem's edges then fall on the built stem's row by row.
